parts.name: base frame

physics.Basic_description: Dark reddish-brown rectangular plastic frame forming the outer perimeter and spine of the case base.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural rigidity and protection for the CD tray and disc inside.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the outer edges or spine of the frame with a parallel jaw gripper to lift or hold the case.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic case walls are thin shells enclosing air, not solid blocks of plastic.

parts.description: Dark reddish-brown rectangular plastic frame forming the outer perimeter and spine of the case base.
parts.function: Provides structural rigidity and protection for the CD tray and disc inside.

parts.name: inner tray

physics.Basic_description: Black matte plastic insert sitting inside the base frame, featuring a central hub area.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the CD securely in place via the central hub and prevents movement during transport.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; usually covered by the disc or flush with the frame.
physics.reason: Thermoformed or injection molded thin plastic sheet forming a shallow tray shape.

parts.description: Black matte plastic insert sitting inside the base frame, featuring a central hub area.
parts.function: Holds the CD securely in place via the central hub and prevents movement during transport.

parts.name: lid shell

physics.Basic_description: Dark reddish-brown flat rectangular panel hinged to the base, matching the frame color.
physics.Functional_description: Covers and protects the CD and inner tray when the case is closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the edge of the lid to open the case or lift the entire object if closed.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic shell typical of CD jewel cases or digipaks, enclosing air.

parts.description: Dark reddish-brown flat rectangular panel hinged to the base, matching the frame color.
parts.function: Covers and protects the CD and inner tray when the case is closed.

parts.name: disc 0 body

physics.Basic_description: White circular optical disc with a central hole and a small marker hole, resting in the tray.
physics.Functional_description: Stores digital audio or data information read by a laser.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp by the outer rim or center hole edges, avoiding the data surface if possible.
physics.reason: CDs are solid 1.2mm thick polycarbonate disks, not hollow shells.

parts.description: White circular optical disc with a central hole and a small marker hole, resting in the tray.
parts.function: Stores digital audio or data information read by a laser.

parts.name: disc 0 marker

physics.Basic_description: Small dark circular mark or hole located near the center of the white disc.
physics.Functional_description: Likely a manufacturing mark, balance hole, or part of the hub clamping mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp independently; part of the disc assembly.
physics.reason: Integral part of the solid polycarbonate disc structure.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
